summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded the node universe around AI data-center power and thermal infrastructure using a two-lane funnel. The reference lane is anchored by Vertiv as the obvious high-attention leader in critical digital infrastructure, power, cooling, and liquid-cooling capacity. The discovery lane highlights Modine, Powell Industries, and IES Holdings as more industrially labeled beneficiaries with direct exposure to data-center cooling, switchgear/power distribution, and electrical/mechanical execution bottlenecks. Market-cap buckets are approximate as of the latest available finance snapshot on 2026-06-12/2026-06-13 UTC and should be refreshed in later layers. Layer 1B expansion finds that the clearest public-market chokepoint evidence sits in electrical distribution and thermal-management hardware rather than in headline compute. Vertiv is the reference leader for power/cooling context. Powell Industries is a high-relevance underfollowed candidate due to medium-voltage switchgear and record data-center orders. Modine and nVent add liquid-cooling, heat-exchanger, CDU, rack-level power, and data-center infrastructure exposure. Key bottleneck claims remain strongest where companies disclose backlog, capacity expansion, AI/data-center customer demand, or specific liquid-cooling portfolios; weaker claims require segment-level revenue validation. Two-lane expansion for the AI data-center power/thermal node. Reference lane: Vertiv remains the obvious benchmark for integrated power, UPS, busway, CDU and liquid-cooling infrastructure. Underfollowed lane: Powell Industries, Modine, and Bel Fuse
